answer_1.quote: We prompted both GPT-3.5 Turbo and GPT-4 with text in ten varieties of English... For each (input, output) pair, annotators assessed the output on 5-point Likert scales for nine qualities...
answer_1.outputs: Generated text responses to informal letters in each English variety

answer_4.quote: Native speakers of each variety were recruited to evaluate the responses via Prolific... For each (input, output) pair, annotators assessed the output on 5-point Likert scales for nine qualities.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated the model outputs on stereotyping, demeaning content, condescension, formality, comprehension, naturalness, warmth, friendliness, and respect.
